answer.says: Ramesh, you know I cannot give you the full wage; the file is with the Directorate. But I will give you the rupees in my pocket for groceries. Buy rice, dal, and vegetables. I will eat what you prepare, and I will pay the rest when the orders come back. Do not let the stove go cold.
answer.thought: The pot is empty because the wallet is empty, a simple material fact that my pride tries to obscure. I have only one hundred and sixty-six rupees, less than the cost of a single bottle of wine, and yet I must command the household to function on this pittance. It is a small, humiliating economy, but the body requires its fuel, and the spirit cannot dwell in an empty house. I will surrender my cash to him, for it is the only currency I possess that he can use, and I will have to survive on the next installment of my salary or the kindness of the neighbours.
